items.caption: A modern drawing of 半 in the Shuowen Lesser Seal tradition, with 八 above 牛. The image illustrates a received seal-script form, not an ancient artifact.
items.alt: Black seal-script strokes arranged as 八 above 牛, forming 半.
items.selection_reason: The candidate is identified as a Shuowen Lesser Seal drawing, and a separate character record labels a Small Seal form of 半. It provides a useful example of the form tradition discussed in the entry.

limitations.text: The image pixels show the seal-style drawing, but they do not establish its ancient date or prove the proposed interpretation of its parts as division and an ox being divided.
